commands.command:
set -euo pipefail; SERIAL=$(adb devices | awk 'NR>1 && $2=="device" {print $1}' | head -n1); adb -s "$SERIAL" shell input tap 540 947; sleep 1; adb -s "$SERIAL" shell uiautomator dump /sdcard/tracker-dbsettings.xml >/dev/null; adb -s "$SERIAL" pull /sdcard/tracker-dbsettings.xml /tmp/tracker-dbsettings.xml >/dev/null; python3 - <<'PY'
import xml.etree.ElementTree as ET
r=ET.parse('/tmp/tracker-dbsettings.xml').getroot()
for n in r.iter('node'):
 t=n.attrib.get('text',''); d=n.attrib.get('content-desc',''); c=n.attrib.get('clickable',''); b=n.attrib.get('bounds','')
 if t or d or c=='true': print(f'text={t!r} desc={d!r} clickable={c} bounds={b}')
PY
